body:
Korean-American Female
Diagnosed with Bipolar Disorder II and ADHD
Fractured left ankle 5 weeks ago
Fractured right pinky toe 1 week ago
I have tried: cannabis, ethanol/alcohol, diphenhydramine, dimenhydrinate, dxm, MDMA/ecstasy, cocaine, cyclobenzaprine, salvia, mood-stabilizers, antidepressants.
This experience was incredibly satisfying in the euphoric effects
But I've never felt so nauseous in my life.
Yesterday 6/5/09
2pm: AMPHETAMINE vyvanse 50mg capsule oral
3pm: elevated mood, increased concentration & awakeness, dry mouth, decreased appetite
5pm: VICODIN(M357 - Mallinckrodt) 5mg-500mg tablet oral
540: slight nausea
6pm: CANNABIS bowl & joints smoked.
620: incredible euphoria. Body is extremely numb. Face feels as if melting rubber. Unable swallow food (nauseous as hell)
7pm: CANNABIS joints. Effects progress higher. Nausea disappears & reappears back and forth
8pm: incredible sexual sensitivity & pleasure for a few minutes, confusion & numbness for a few, back and forth. Nausea is gone?or possibly just simply forgotten during sexual encounter.
9pm: marijuana high is completely gone. Terrible headache, dizziness, nausea. Surroundings seem unfamiliar. Conversations are hard to follow. Extremely dry mouth.
11pm: CANNABIS joint. Nausea decreases. Dry mouth persists. Dizziness decreases. Still confused & lost. Stoned as balls.
12pm: EXTREME nausea. Marijuana high is gone but body is still numb
3am: nausea decreases extremely. Unable to sleep
5am: insomnia
6am-7am: wrote/typed my experience. Nausea is almost completely gone. Headache. Still confused.
The euphoric effects were amazing, but I felt too sick to enjoy them completely. If the nausea had been controlled, this would've been an extremely pleasurable experience. I felt my stomach jerking up and down throughout the whole day, and literally had to hold my breath to keep myself from puking.
Were the results worth the intense urge to throw up? Eh, half and half. I will most likely repeat this combination with a lower dose of vicodin.
